[Verse 1]
[Cm]As the night arrives
the day concedes
her crown
[Eb]
In the dying light
the shadows grow
[Eb]

[Pre-Chorus]
[Cm]When the world is dark
[Eb]and still without
[Fm]a sound
[Cm]That which was
[Ab]hidden is
[Gm]shown
[Fm]

[Chorus]
[Cm]Tears of sorrow
[Eb]flood the land All
[Cm]that has been shall be
[Bb]again The
[Cm]dead will rise and the
[Eb]living must depart
[Fm]
[Cm]And
[Cm]what if all you've seen
[Eb]are lies
[Cm]When the veil is from
[Bb]your eyes And you
[Cm]face the infinite
[Eb]with fear in your heart?
[Fm]
[Cm]

[Bb]

[Verse 2]
[Cm]The wind blows cold
as the days begin
to wane
[Eb]
[Cm]The Lord of the dead
assumes his throne
[Eb]

[Pre-Chorus]
[Cm]When men have gone
[Eb]and only ghosts
[Fm]remain
[Cm]That which was
[Ab]secret is
[Gm]known
[Fm]

[Chorus]
[Cm]Tears of sorrow flood
[Eb]the land All
[Cm]that has been shall be
[Bb]again And the
[Cm]moon shines over the sea
[Eb]as the mother of man
[Fm]
[Cm]
[Cm]Somewhere seven ships
[Eb]collide
[Cm]Seven sailors lose
[Bb]their lives But their
[Cm]voyage continues on
[Eb]the other side
